body: Don’t call this crystal soft! It may have a soft exterior, but Selenite’s metaphysical strength is tough on blocks and negative energies. The shield that these Mini Selenite Pyramids cast is anything but mini. A crystal of liquid light, the twinning striations that trap light, and give Selenite its trademark light reflection, are the same ones that ensnare negative energy within a space. Making grids of Selenite crystals is an easy way to ensure that both your home space and mental space have energetic clarity. Used to cleanse other crystals, Selenite has profound energetic cleansing properties. It fuses with the crown chakra to purify the mind of the self-doubt and judgements which poison attitude and taint perspective. The high-vibrational intensity of each Selenite pyramid has proven a fast-acting remedy to energetic blocks forged out of anxieties and fears.
